description: Returns upcoming cultural events, concerts, nightlife (open mic, comedy/stand-up, trivia/pub quiz, bars), and active museum exhibitions in Reykjavík from curated KV feeds (next 30 days) with https booking_url (max 20).

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. music, concert, theater, exhibition, talk, family, fair, open_mic, comedy, trivia, bar, nightlife, literature).

free_only.description: Only return entries with confirmed free admission (default false).

from_date.description: Optional inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in Reykjavík).

include_exhibitions.description: Include ongoing exhibitions alongside dated events (default true).

limit.description: Maximum total items to return (1-20, default 20).

query.description: Optional keyword search across title, venue, address, and category.

name: get_events
title: Get Upcoming Events & Exhibitions in Reykjavík
